pages.text: Combat here is $(bold)Epic Fight$(): combos, dodges, guards, and a special move per weapon.$(br2)$(bold)K$() switches Battle and Mining mode. Combos only work in Battle mode.$(br2)Left-click combos, hold right-click to guard, $(bold)Mouse 5$() dodges, $(bold)N$() locks on, $(bold)=$() fires your weapon's innate skill.

$(bold)Skill Books$() drop from any mob you kill yourself (about 2.5%). Right-click to learn, then press $(bold)`$() to open the Skill Editor and slot it. Passives always work; weapon skills need the right weapon type.

$(bold)Weapons of Miracles$() and $(bold)EpicFight: Resurrection$() add more weapons and skills to the same system. $(bold)Shield Expansion$() makes shields matter: time your block for a parry.$(br2)Spend twenty minutes fighting zombies in Battle mode before your first boss. It is a different game.
